## Change

What changes, and why? Link the issue or research question.

## Evidence

Exact commands, environment and passed/failed/skipped counts. Distinguish
synthetic checks from observed data and new results from historical evidence.

## Data and permissions

Does this change capture, storage, disclosure, deletion or actions?
Explain defaults, consent, stop behaviour and tests. Never attach personal data.

## Limitations

Known gaps, compatibility impact and anything intentionally not tested.
